title: 第 84章 五行神光第 83章 正是悟道之时
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 五色流转的速度骤然加快，青赤黄白黑交织成一片模糊的光晕。
然后，白色从中脱颖而出，将其他四色尽数压了下去。
整团光华化为一道纯粹的白芒，边缘处有细碎的寒光跳跃不定。
他将剑指一并，运力一送。
白芒激射而出。
快得几乎超出了肉眼的极限，沈回的视线甚至没能跟上它的轨迹。
他只看见自己指尖白光一闪，下一瞬，数十丈外的崖壁上便多了一个洞。
他走过去查看。
那洞口不过指节粗细，却深得看不见底。
洞壁光滑如镜，与之前那几处凹坑一般无二，可深度与穿透力却不可同日而语。
沈回立在崖壁前，陷入沉思：
“还是不对，但好像摸到些门道了。”
接下来的半个时辰里，他开始逐一试验。
他将五色光华的本源之力分别往五行属性的方向催动。
往锐金靠拢，光华便化作一线白光。
锋锐无匹，其速如电，百丈距离瞬息而至，洞穿山石如穿腐土。
往厚土靠拢，光华变得沉凝厚重，色作深黄。
出手时无声无息，触物之后却如山岳倾压，将一片山崖碾得粉碎，威力之巨连他自己都暗暗吃惊。
往柔水靠拢，光华化作一泓透明的波光，形态不定，可聚可散。
聚则如箭，散则如雾，能从细微处渗透，由内而外地瓦解目标。
往青木靠拢，光华变得绵长柔韧，色转青翠。出手之后竟能随他心意转向，在空中划出蜿蜒的轨迹，如藤蔓般缠绕而上。
而一旦缠住目标，便会疯狂生长，直到将对方绞得粉碎。
往烈火靠拢，光华骤然变得狂暴炽烈，赤红的光芒刺目欲盲。
这一击出手时声势最大，轰然如雷霆，落处山石炸裂，方圆数丈尽成焦土。
试到最后，他将五色光华重新分化，五色各居其位，青赤黄白黑在掌心轮转不休。
他心念一动，五色便随心而变。
要快便快，要慢便慢，要刚则刚，要柔则柔。
五行的一切特性，他皆可在掌中随意切换，了无滞碍。
他又试着同时催动五种特性，体内灵气顿时狂涌而出，神光大放。
便在此时，灵台忽然一震，面板之上骤然浮现出一行字迹。
【已领悟本命道途：五行神光】
沈回一怔。
五行神光？那不是孔宣的看家本领吗？
content_en:
The speed of the flow of five colors suddenly accelerated, and green, red, yellow, white and black intertwined into a blurry halo.
Then, white stands out, overwhelming the other four colors.
The entire ball of light turned into a pure white light, with fine cold light jumping around at the edge.
He pointed his sword together and sent his energy away.
White light shot out.
It was so fast that it almost exceeded the limit of the naked eye, and Shen's returning gaze couldn't even follow its trajectory.
He only saw a flash of white light at his fingertips, and the next moment, there was a hole in the cliff dozens of feet away.
He walked over to check.
The opening of the hole was no more than the thickness of a knuckle, but it was so deep that the bottom could not be seen.
The cave wall is as smooth as a mirror, just like the previous pits, but the depth and penetration are different.
Shen Hui stood in front of the cliff, lost in thought:
"It's still wrong, but I seem to have found some clues."
In the next half hour, he began to experiment one by one.
He mobilized the original power of the five colors of brilliance in the direction of the five elements' attributes.
Move closer to Ruijin, and the brilliance turns into a ray of white light.
Its sharpness is unparalleled, its speed is as fast as lightning, it can cover a distance of a hundred feet in an instant, and it can penetrate rocks like rotten soil.
Moving closer to the thick soil, the brilliance becomes dense and thick, and the color becomes deep yellow.
There was no sound when he took action, but when he touched the object, it was like a mountain pressing down, crushing a cliff into pieces. The power was so powerful that even he was secretly surprised.
Move closer to the soft water, and the brilliance turns into a transparent wave of light, with an indefinite shape that can be gathered or dispersed.
When gathered, it is like an arrow, and when dispersed, it is like mist. It can penetrate from subtle points and disintegrate the target from the inside out.
Moving closer to the green wood, the brilliance becomes long and flexible, and the color turns green. After taking action, he was able to turn according to his will, drawing a winding trajectory in the air, winding up like a vine.
Once it entangles the target, it will grow crazily until it crushes the opponent.
Moving closer to the fire, the light suddenly became violent and blazing, and the red light was blinding.
This attack was the loudest when it was launched, with a bang like thunder. The rocks where it hit exploded, and several feet in the area were turned into scorched earth.
At the end of the experiment, he re-differentiated the five-color brilliance. Each of the five colors occupied their respective positions, with green, red, yellow, white and black rotating endlessly in the palm of his hand.
As soon as he thought about it, the five colors changed according to his heart.
If you want to go fast, go fast, if you want to go slow, go slow, if you want to be hard, be firm, if you want to be soft, be soft.
All the characteristics of the Five Elements can be switched at will in the palm of his hand without any hindrance.
He tried to activate the five characteristics at the same time, and the spiritual energy in his body suddenly surged out, and the divine light shined.
At this moment, the spiritual platform suddenly shook, and a line of writing suddenly appeared on the panel.
[Understood the path of destiny: the divine light of the five elements]
Shen Hui was startled.
Five Elements Divine Light? Isn’t that Kong Xuan’s special skill?
title_en: Chapter 84 The Five Elements Divine Light Chapter 83 It’s the Time of Enlightenment
